verdict.rationale: The only programmatic discovery evidence is CLI commands for searching the registry and finding tools. The vendor's own shutdown notice says the Smithery API, CLI and SDKs stopped working on October 31, 2026, and that no documented API surface remains. Smithery survives only as a public, non-proxied registry, and probes found no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt or docs.md, so there is no evidence of a working, documented registry or catalog API an agent can query.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can query the platform's registry or catalog through a documented API to discover servers and tools programmatically
